subject: POC security follow-up — VPC isolation options & compliance artifacts
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Meyer <sarah.meyer@orthohealth.com>, Rajiv Patel <procurement@orthohealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC security follow-up — VPC isolation options & compliance artifacts

Hi Sarah / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and the asks we promised to follow up on: 

- SOC 2 status: you mentioned OrthoHealth is SOC 2 Type II in progress with an expected report by Q1 2027 — if you can share the interim control matrices or a SOC 2 snapshot, that will speed our procurement review.
- Privacy/regulatory: you flagged HIPAA for PHI flows and GDPR for EU patients. Please confirm which data classes we should assume for the POC (PHI vs. pseudonymized).
- Deployment topology: we discussed two options: (A) VPC peering with strict ingress rules, and (B) fully air-gapped on-prem with a one-way data export. For the POC we'd like to validate option A first. Could you share the network contact or the person who owns firewall/peering work?
- Vendor security questionnaire: if you have an existing XLSX, please send it; otherwise we can provide a short intake form.

Attached is a short Redwood POC prep checklist that outlines the artifacts we typically need and an initial list of firewall rules we ask customers to review. Once we have your SOC 2 excerpt and the questionnaire, Neha will put together a minimal evidence pack for your team to review.

Proposed next steps:
1) Sarah / Rajiv: send the vendor questionnaire + SOC 2 excerpt (if available)
2) Redwood (Neha/Irene): share a first-pass isolation sketch and a short data-flow diagram by EOD tomorrow
3) Schedule a 30-min follow-up with network/security owners to validate peering rules

Thanks again — cc'ing Neha and Vanessa so they can loop in engineering and solutions.

Best,

Irene Choi
Solution Architect, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_private_prep_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Sarah Meyer <sarah.meyer@orthohealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <procurement@orthohealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC security follow-up — VPC isolation options & compliance artifacts

Irene —

Thanks for the clear recap. Attaching the vendor questionnaire and a redacted SOC 2 excerpt (service-organization controls summary) — both are preliminary but should cover your procurement needs.

Couple of notes/questions on your bullets: 
- Data classes: primary use will include PHI (lab results + identifiers) so HIPAA controls apply. We will anonymize for demo data where possible, but please plan the POC assuming PHI in-stream.
- Network: I can loop in our network lead, Carlos Navarro (c.navarro@orthohealth.com). Carlos manages peering and firewall exceptions.
- Air-gapped: we have one site (Site 3) that can be air-gapped for later evaluation; for the initial POC we prefer VPC peering to avoid hardware procurement delays.

I'll also note the procurement team (Rajiv) will validate contract terms after we confirm the evidence.

Attaching: vendor_questionnaire.xlsx, soc2_excerpt.pdf

—Sarah
Sarah Meyer
Security & Compliance Lead
OrthoHealth Inc.
[Attachments: vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), soc2_excerpt.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Navarro <c.navarro@orthohealth.com>, Sarah Meyer <sarah.meyer@orthohealth.com>, Rajiv Patel <procurement@orthohealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC security follow-up — VPC isolation options & compliance artifacts

Carlos / Team —

Great to e-meet you, Carlos. Per Sarah: thank you for taking point on peering. I've attached our first-pass isolation sketch showing the proposed VPC peering layout, required subnets, and minimal ingress rules for tokenized ingress (TLS + mTLS on service port). This is intentionally conservative — we can tighten NAT and BGP rules once your network team confirms.

Things we included in the sketch (attached):
- Separate subnets for model serving and customer data with no direct routing between them
- Ingress limited to the OrthoHealth peering IP range + our management plane via VPN
- KV cache retained only in-GPU memory during session (we do not persist PHI by default for POC) — Neha: please add the short data retention bullet here.

Ask: Carlos, can you confirm the peering CIDR you prefer and whether your team requires a dedicated transit gateway or a simple VPC peering arrangement? Also, please flag any extra compliance checks you want us to include in the questionnaire.

Proposed meeting slots to validate topology (30 min):
- Wed 2026-10-07 09:00–09:30 PT
- Wed 2026-10-07 10:30–11:00 PT
- Thu 2026-10-08 08:00–08:30 PT

Links: HubSpot POC record: https://hubspot.company/contacts/ORH-57 — shared drive folder with artifacts: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/POC-OrthoHealth-2026

Attachment: isolation_sketch_v1.png

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Solution Architect, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: isolation_sketch_v1.png (image/png)]
From: Rajiv Patel <procurement@orthohealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Sarah Meyer <sarah.meyer@orthohealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC security follow-up — VPC isolation options & compliance artifacts

Irene / Sarah —

Thanks — procurement will start reviewing the questionnaire today. A couple quick asks from our side: 
- Can Redwood provide a one-page data-flow statement for the POC (who sees PHI, what is persisted, where logs are stored)? This helps us map to our BAAs.
- If you support tokenization or field-level redaction in the POC, please call it out explicitly.

We'll confirm which one of our network slots (Carlos) can take your 30-min review tomorrow 09:00 PT — Rajiv (procurement) will be present for contract-related clarifications.

Rajiv Patel
Senior Contracts Manager
OrthoHealth Inc.
